subject.title: perf(agents): reuse media tool availability during tool prep

question: Does the shared media availability plan remain the authoritative registration contract for image understanding and all three generation tools, including workspace- and auth-scoped edge cases?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the decision boundary rather than merely caching a pure helper; approving the permanent contract requires owner judgment after comparing it with the factories’ former predicates.

options.title: Confirm shared-plan equivalence
options.body: Approve the optimization after the responsible agent-tools owner confirms the shared plan covers all former registration inputs and the branch is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Keep local predicates
options.body: Retain each factory’s local availability decision and pursue a narrower performance improvement if the shared plan cannot be made contract-equivalent.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared-plan equivalence
recommendation.body: Approve the optimization after the responsible agent-tools owner confirms the shared plan covers all former registration inputs and the branch is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline connects this person to the prior review cycle; repository-history ownership could not be established from the supplied evidence.
